about: The calibration set (2026-11-23): small cases that together reach every mechanism the development points reach in the CA model's counters on the base; run the ones that reach what you changed, on the RTL and on the model, with the trace gate. `chosen` covers all of them that any case the RTL simulator can run reaches; `by_mechanism` lists every such case, smallest first; `unreached` names what only larger programs reach.

mechanisms.all three cores: every core runs part of the program (core_N_instructions on all three)
mechanisms.dirty writebacks: dirty lines written back from the home caches (uncore_writebacks)
mechanisms.fpu / sfu stalls: waits on the FPU or the SFU (core_N_stall_fpu, sfu_queue_cycles)
mechanisms.lsu stalls: waits on the load/store unit (core_N_stall_lsu, lsu_wait_cycles)
mechanisms.matrix engine waits: waits on the matrix engine (core_N_stall_mtx, matrix_engine_wait_cycles)
mechanisms.mshr merges: misses merged into an outstanding MSHR (uncore_merges)
mechanisms.response / writeback queue full: the home's response or writeback queue full (uncore_rsq_full, wbq_full)
mechanisms.several launches: a program of more than one launch (chip_grid_launches + chip_single_launches)
